replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Absolutely. Maths makes me nervous because I never felt confident with it. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven’t tried AI for maths. Honestly, I avoid it as much as possible. When I need help, I ask friends or look up simple explanations online, but even then,it’s overwhelming.

I’m not sure what stationary points are, but I think they’re where the graph stops going up or down? Maybe you take the derivative and set it to zero? But I’d have to look that up because calculus was never my strong suit.
replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis sounds complicated. It’s something to do with statistics and reducing data into simpler parts, right? replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: I think LLMs could help by explaining concepts in different ways until students understand.
